content.title: Qualys (NASDAQ:QLYS) Exceeds Q3 Expectations, Stock Soars
content.summary: Cybersecurity cloud platform provider Qualys (NASDAQ:QLYS) reported revenue ahead of Wall Streets expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 10.4% year on year to $169.9 million. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was optimistic at $173 million at the midpoint, 2.1% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.86 per share was 19.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
